source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
At the end of either player's [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), if no models are embarked in this **TRANSPORT**, you may pick 1 **YNNARI INFANTRY** unit of yours that:

- only has models from units named in the Transport ability of this unit
- has no more than 6 models
- lies wholly within 6" of the **TRANSPORT**

If the picked unit is outside the [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of every enemy unit, it may embark in this **TRANSPORT**, even if it disembarked earlier in the turn from this **TRANSPORT**.
